acceptanceRule.GENUINE_MOVE: accept iff: SEC share count (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, else us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding; original as-reported value = earliest filing per period end) from two filings bracketing the event: pre.end <= prevWeek and >= prevWeek-200d, post.end >= max(maxDailyDate, week-start) and <= week+200d; |ln(post/pre)| <= ln(1.25); no STRONG split filing (8-K with item 3.03/5.03 containing a split phrase, or XBRL StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1 = k or 1/k with end within +-30d), no WEAK split mention (split phrase in any 8-K/6-K non-exhibit-10 document filed within +-30d), no distribution/spin-off indicator for DOWN moves, no provider split in the week, event week >= 2001-01-01 (EDGAR full-text coverage), not a round trip (move reverses by >= half (log) within 4 weeks), identity check CONSISTENT (dei:EntityPublicFloat / (raw series price x shares) in [0.2, 1.1] for at least one float fact within +-730d).
acceptanceRule.SPIN_OFF_DISTRIBUTION: accept as PRICE_RETURN_ONLY iff the distribution (asset, ratio, date) is documented by a quoted original SEC filing and shares are continuous; total-return use requires the documented distribution value.
acceptanceRule.SPLIT_UNADJUSTED: never accepted by the registry; requires a corrected series generation (pre-event closes multiplied by the price factor 1/k (DOWN) or k (UP)) produced by the series producer and re-validated.
acceptanceRule.PROVIDER_SPLIT_UNSUPPORTED: never accepted by the registry; provider split factor contradicted by SEC share counts -> producer must remove the factor and re-publish.
acceptanceRule.bindings: every entry binds securityId, canonicalId, event week, prevWeek, weeklyRatio (6 dp) and the sha256 of the series bytes it was derived from; any mismatch invalidates the entry.
